verdict.rationale: Firebase documents substantial programmatic surfaces beyond the console. The official CLI deploys code and assets, interacts with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. The official MCP server can create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore data, and a community report notes an HTTP API was added. However, nothing claims full API/UI parity, no OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths 404), and some console features (Gemini chat, Crashlytics insights, messaging-campaign analysis) are only described as console experiences. Missing for 10: an explicit documented console-to-API parity guarantee, a published machine-readable API spec, programmatic access to console-only AI/analytics features, and independent corroboration of parity.
